description: This file defines the class NonGmailSentFolderHandler, responsible for managing email handling related to non-Gmail SMTP accounts in SuiteCRM, including storing sent emails in the appropriate folders and handling related errors.

classes.name: NonGmailSentFolderHandler
classes.description: Handles storing sent emails for non-Gmail accounts and manages related error states.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that logs unhandled errors upon object destruction.

methods.name: clearLastError
methods.description: Clears the last error and logs if there was an existing error.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the last error code.

methods.name: setLastError
methods.description: Sets the last error code after validating it as an integer.

methods.name: storeInSentFolder
methods.description: Public method to store an outbound email into the Sent folder, considering different account types.

methods.name: storeInNonGmailSentMailBox
methods.description: Helper method to handle storing email in a non-Gmail account's folder.

methods.name: getProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolder
methods.description: Generates a diagnostic message for storage issues.

methods.name: connectToNonGmailServer
methods.description: Connects to the email server for non-Gmail accounts to facilitate email storage.

methods.name: copyToNonGmailSentFolder
methods.description: Copies the email to the specified folder on the mail server.
